localChanges: Remove the dedicated Operative View button, handler, QA export and stale step note.
Use two-axis upright orbit for ordinary drag; Alt/Option-drag rolls the camera in place without orbiting the head.
Reverse the plain-drag azimuth and elevation signs so the visible anatomy follows the pointer horizontally and vertically; preserve Alt/Option roll and pan mappings.
Read the eye direction from the camera matrix's third row and preserve azimuth at overhead poles so successive ordinary drags remain continuous.
Keep interaction rendering active for the entire held gesture and debounce restoration after final pointer release, avoiding mid-drag canvas resize and synchronous picking on slow frames.
Measure the drag threshold from pointerdown displacement rather than accumulating oscillating hand jitter; never select after a completed drag returns to its start.
Ignore pointer movement until a 5 CSS-pixel drag threshold is crossed to filter press jitter.
Discard pending pick work at drag start and suppress picking-buffer render and synchronous pixel readback during active movement, including pose-animation redraws.
Render active pointer frames at device-pixel ratio 1 with reduced procedural-noise quality; restore full display quality and picking after 140 ms idle while keeping click picking immediate.
Update accessible gesture instructions, reference documentation and interaction regression checks.
geometry: All six anatomy chunks, material/deformation shaders, CSS, loader and anatomy build modules are unchanged from upstream.
